title: velocirepo: data health
description:
velocirepo checks the data every night. This issue lists the findings that are open; it's rewritten by every run.

| | Check | Where | What | Since | ID |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ❌ | `fetch.failed` | github/quarto-gallery | comments: github REST API returned 404: {"message":"Not Found","documentation_url":"https://docs.github.com/rest/issues/comments#list-issue-comments-for-a-repository","status":"404"} | 2026-11-17 | `412d36e13ef3` |
| ⚠️ | `diff.repaired` | github/mizu shikokuchuo/mizu-r | 1 content entries removed by the repair github/mizu 2000-01-01..2026-11-16 (repos: 1) in commit c3ca4279ba8b (commit c3ca4279ba8b) | 2026-11-17 | `004c0a16c90f` |
| ⚠️ | `data.volume` | github/shiny-r rstudio/shiny | no data for the last 3 days, while it had data on 20 of the 28 days before | 2026-11-17 | `17effd5faf59` |
| ⚠️ | `data.volume` | pypi/biobouncer | no data for the last 3 days, while it had data on 20 of the 28 days before | 2026-11-17 | `26f1a115d04a` |
| ⚠️ | `data.freshness` | github/quarto-gallery quarto-dev/quarto-gallery | quarto-dev/quarto-gallery was last fetched through 2026-11-15, 2 days behind; the limit is 1 | 2026-11-17 | `46440b11a94f` |
| ⚠️ | `data.integrity` | github/connect-actions | duplicate: 2 times in events/github/connect-actions/2026-11-02.jsonl | 2026-11-07 | `53d9df8577b3` |
| ⚠️ | `data.volume` | github/shiny rstudio/shiny | no data for the last 3 days, while it had data on 20 of the 28 days before | 2026-11-17 | `5a659b61e71c` |
| ⚠️ | `data.volume` | github/plotnine has2k1/plotnine | no data for the last 3 days, while it had data on 21 of the 28 days before | 2026-11-17 | `63dcdfd0e682` |
| ⚠️ | `reconcile.unavailable` | github/elf cak/elf | no reference totals to compare with: the repository can't be searched | 2026-11-17 | `6aede4b017ce` |
| ⚠️ | `data.volume` | github/py-shinywidgets posit-dev/py-shinywidgets | no data for the last 3 days, while it had data on 20 of the 28 days before | 2026-11-17 | `a4798b102816` |
| ⚠️ | `data.integrity` | github/connect-actions | line 4: duplicate of line 3 | 2026-11-10 | `c87c1ecabc49` |
| ⚠️ | `reconcile.unavailable` | github/shinyfiles thomasp85/shinyFiles | no reference totals to compare with: the repository can't be searched | 2026-11-17 | `f34ec709f342` |

To accept a finding, add its ID to `velocirepo/checks.toml`:

```toml
[[accept]]
id = "…"
reason = "…"
```

Last updated by https://github.com/posit-dev/devrel-io/actions/runs/44057166896

title: Include more Posit R packages
description: I've noticed that tidymodels packages and commons are not included in this data. Happy to send a PR to make that happen for that github org and for that package specifically, but I'm also wondering if we could apply some rule that would have caught both of those and added them automatically.
